finalResult.nextParagraphText: “Best advice is to stay nearby, ready to observe the outcome and celebrate the result,” the Viper shrugged. “Even if he fails, I believe history will be made today.”
finalResult.previousParagraphText: “No, you aren’t allowed to,” the Viper shook his head. “So just trust that he’s the best there is, and I believe that even if Jake fails, his instincts won’t allow him to risk too much.”
